author: Brad Traversy
text:
Do any of you wear blue light glasses or whatever they're called? Do they help you in any way?

My vision has gotten significantly more blurry over the last few months. Kind of scary actually. I'm curious to see if the glasses would help.

topReplies.author: Brian Ball
topReplies.text:
If you go that route, keep them clean.

How does "eyes" even make glasses dirty?

topReplies.author: Michael Cacciano
topReplies.text: I recently got a pair with my prescription. My eyes were gwtting so dry I didnt even wanna work. 10 ish hours a day on my pc. It's only been like 2 weeks but I would say it's noticeable for me. Eyes are less dry, and I'm not sure, but I feel like I'm sleeping better also.

topReplies.author: Brad Traversy
topReplies.text: Yeah dryness is a huge issue for me too. I wear contacts but can we nly wear them about three or four hours before it feels like sandpaper

topReplies.author: Dima 🇺🇦
topReplies.text:
Try these exercises everybody recommends like changing focus - sounds stupid but actually helps.

As for glasses - did not notice any effect 😕

topReplies.author: Brad Traversy
topReplies.text: I know the 20-20-20 rule. I tell people to do it but i forget myself lol.  Have to set an alarm

topReplies.author: Nick P.
topReplies.text: What helped me more than these glasses were eye drops (artificial tears)

topReplies.author: Brad Traversy
topReplies.text: Yeah I need to use these more. My eyes are like sandpaper. Thanks

topReplies.author: PHILIP
topReplies.text: I have never worn blue light glasses and my eyes are fine. Each person is different.

topReplies.author: Brad Traversy
topReplies.text: I have always had vision issues. Poor sight, dryness, floaters. Im jealous of people that can just see lol.

topReplies.author: Kevin Powell
topReplies.text:
I had to get glasses, and since I'm in front of the computer all day I figured it wouldn't hurt.

I can't really compare to eye strain without them, since they're prescription, so when I don't wear them it's more tiring on my eyes.

topReplies.author: Csaba Kissi
topReplies.text: I have something like that implemented in the glasses I use in front of my mac. Everything is changing above 40😞

topReplies.author: ThePrimeagen
topReplies.text: I did for some time, they really do help. I've been fixing to buy some new ones

topReplies.author: Julia Furst Morgado
topReplies.text: I was having the same problem so I bought blue light glasses and felt it helped a little bit. I’ve been also trying to reduce screen time every week and keeping screens out of the bedroom (my sleep thanks me).

topReplies.author: flavio
topReplies.text: My eyes BURN if I forget to wear them and use the regular glasses instead

topReplies.author: Devin Ford 📚
topReplies.text: My prescription glasses have the blue light filter in the glasses. I probably do 70% glasses and 30% contacts when coding, and I don’t really get headaches often anymore, but if I do, it’s usually when I’m wearing the contact… so they might be helping but can’t say for sure.
